newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Three die in Bangladesh as bus rolls into river.
newsitem.headline: Three die in Bangladesh as bus rolls into river.

text.p: At least three people were killed and 10 others injured on Sunday when a bus rolled into the river at Aricha ferry terminal, 100 km (60 miles) northwest of Dhaka, officials said.
The accident occurred as the bus, carrying 40 passengers, was trying to give way to an incoming bus while disembarking at the terminal.
The bus was only partially submerged but three people suffocated and 10 others were hurt as they tried to get out.
